messages.text:
"Create a 2D pixel-art mobile MMORPG inspired by Rucoy Online, with a top-down camera and a fantasy world.

MOBILE CONTROLS:

- Touch joystick for character movement.
- Tap monsters to target and automatically attack them.
- Mobile-friendly interface and buttons.
- Smooth touch controls.

GAMEPLAY:

- Three classes: Warrior, Archer and Mage.
- HP, MP, XP and leveling system.
- Monsters attack players and respawn after death.
- Different monsters: Slimes, Wolves, Skeletons, Goblins, Orcs and Dragons.
- Stronger monsters give better XP and loot.
- Combat animations and floating damage numbers.

WORLD:

- Starting village, forests, caves and dungeons.
- NPCs, quests, shops and bosses.
- Multiple areas with increasing difficulty.
- Beautiful fantasy environments with pixel-art graphics.

ITEMS AND EQUIPMENT:

- Functional inventory and equipment system.
- Weapons, armor, helmets, boots and potions.
- Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary items.
- Monsters drop equipment, materials and gold.
- Equipment improves character stats.

INTERFACE:

- HP, MP and XP bars.
- Character level and name.
- Inventory, equipment, skills and quest menus.
- Mini-map and gold counter.
- Clean mobile-friendly UI.

PROGRESSION:

- Experience and leveling system.
- Character attributes and skills.
- Automatic saving of character progress.
- Shops where players can buy and sell items.

FUTURE MULTIPLAYER SUPPORT:

Build the architecture from the beginning so real-time multiplayer can be added later without rewriting the entire game.

Prepare:

- Server-based architecture.
- Unique player IDs and accounts.
- Server-side character and inventory data.
- Real-time player and monster synchronization.
- Expandable systems for chat, friends, trading, guilds and PvP.
- Database-ready character progression and world data.

FUTURE MONETIZATION:

Prepare the game for:

- Premium currency (Gems).
- VIP memberships.
- Cosmetic skins and outfits.
- Premium shop.
- Additional inventory slots.
- Google Play and Apple App Store payments.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Use clean, modular and expandable code.
- Keep gameplay, UI, networking and data systems separate.
- Make all features functional, not just visual placeholders.
- Make the game easy to expand with new maps, monsters, items and features.
- Avoid hardcoded systems that make future development difficult.

IMPORTANT:
Do not implement multiplayer or real-money payments yet. Only prepare the architecture for them.

Start by creating a fully playable mobile game with movement, maps, monsters, combat, inventory and leveling.

Build and test each system step by step. Make sure existing features continue working when new features are added.

The final goal is to create a complete, expandable 2D mobile MMORPG

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
